# Fintech Disruption: Traditional Banking vs Digital Finance (2015–2024)

## Overview
Four datasets tracking the global shift from traditional banking to fintech-driven digital finance across four regions (North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America) over a ten-year period from 2015 to 2024.

## Data Source

### digital_payment_penetration
Annual digital payment adoption rate as a percentage of the adult population. Fields: `year` (integer, 2015–2024), `region` (string, 4 categories), `penetration_pct` (float, 18.3–91.2%). Represents share of adults who made at least one digital payment transaction in the year.

### traditional_bank_branches
Total number of physical bank branch locations in thousands. Fields: `year` (integer, 2015–2024), `region` (string, 4 categories), `branches_k` (float, 58.6–315.8 thousand). Covers commercial and retail bank branches.

### neobank_users
Cumulative registered users of digital-only banks (neobanks) in millions. Fields: `year` (integer, 2016–2024), `region` (string, 4 categories), `users_m` (float, 0.8–498.3 million). Starts from 2016 when neobanks began gaining traction.

### digital_bank_licenses
Cumulative count of full digital banking licenses approved by national regulators. Fields: `year` (integer, 2015–2024), `region` (string, 4 categories), `cumulative_licenses` (integer, 0–85).

## Data Notes
- All figures are estimated composites across countries within each region
- Digital payment penetration includes mobile wallets, online banking transfers, and contactless card payments
- Neobank user counts include registered accounts; active user rates vary by region
- License counts reflect full banking licenses only, excluding e-money or payment institution licenses
- The 2020 spike in digital adoption reflects pandemic-accelerated behavioral shifts

import numpy as np

    data = json.load(f)

# ── Professional color palette ──
DIGITAL_BLUE  = '#1A5276'   # digital payments
BRANCH_RED    = '#C0392B'   # branch decline
NEO_TEAL      = '#148F77'   # neobank users
LICENSE_GOLD  = '#B7950B'   # license count
BG            = '#FCFCFC'
GRID_C        = '#E8E8E8'
TEXT_DARK     = '#2C3E50'
TEXT_MED      = '#5D6D7E'

REGIONS = ['Asia-Pacific', 'Europe', 'North America', 'Latin America']
REGION_LABELS = ['Asia-Pacific', 'Europe', 'North America', 'Latin America']

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(18, 12))
fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG)
axes = axes.flatten()

for idx, region in enumerate(REGIONS):
    ax = axes[idx]
    ax.set_facecolor(BG)

    # ── Extract region data ──
    pen  = [d for d in data['digital_payment_penetration']['data'] if d['region'] == region]
    br   = [d for d in data['traditional_bank_branches']['data'] if d['region'] == region]
    neo  = [d for d in data['neobank_users']['data'] if d['region'] == region]
    lic  = [d for d in data['digital_bank_licenses']['data'] if d['region'] == region]

    y_pen   = [d['year'] for d in pen]
    v_pen   = [d['penetration_pct'] for d in pen]
    y_br    = [d['year'] for d in br]
    v_br    = [d['branches_k'] for d in br]
    y_neo   = [d['year'] for d in neo]
    v_neo   = [d['users_m'] for d in neo]
    y_lic   = [d['year'] for d in lic]
    v_lic   = [d['cumulative_licenses'] for d in lic]

    # ── Left axis: Digital Payment Penetration ──
    color_digital = DIGITAL_BLUE
    ax.plot(y_pen, v_pen, color=color_digital, linewidth=3.0,
            marker='D', markersize=5.5, markerfacecolor='white',
            markeredgecolor=color_digital, markeredgewidth=2.0,
            zorder=6, clip_on=False)
    ax.set_ylabel('Digital Payment Penetration (%)', color=color_digital,
                  fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', labelpad=8)
    ax.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor=color_digital, labelsize=9)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 105)

    # ── Right axis: Traditional Bank Branches ──
    ax2 = ax.twinx()
    color_branch = BRANCH_RED
    ax2.plot(y_br, v_br, color=color_branch, linewidth=3.0,
             marker='s', markersize=5.5, markerfacecolor='white',
             markeredgecolor=color_branch, markeredgewidth=2.0,
             linestyle='--', dashes=(7, 4), zorder=6, clip_on=False)
    ax2.set_ylabel('Bank Branches (thousands)', color=color_branch,
                   fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', labelpad=8)
    ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor=color_branch, labelsize=9)

    # ── Neobank users as subtle area fill behind branches ──
    ax3 = ax.twinx()
    ax3.spines['right'].set_position(('outward', 62))
    ax3.spines['right'].set_color(NEO_TEAL)
    ax3.spines['right'].set_linewidth(0.6)
    ax3.fill_between(y_neo, v_neo, alpha=0.12, color=NEO_TEAL, zorder=1)
    ax3.plot(y_neo, v_neo, color=NEO_TEAL, linewidth=1.4, alpha=0.7,
             zorder=3)
    ax3.set_ylabel('Neobank Users (M)', color=NEO_TEAL, fontsize=8,
                   fontweight='bold', labelpad=4)
    ax3.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor=NEO_TEAL, labelsize=7)
    ax3.set_ylim(0, max(v_neo) * 1.2)

    # ── License count as small bar chart inset ──
    ax4 = ax.twinx()
    ax4.spines['right'].set_position(('outward', 124))
    ax4.spines['right'].set_color(LICENSE_GOLD)
    ax4.spines['right'].set_linewidth(0.6)
    ax4.bar(y_lic, v_lic, width=0.5, color=LICENSE_GOLD, alpha=0.22,
            edgecolor=LICENSE_GOLD, linewidth=0.4, zorder=1)
    ax4.set_ylabel('Licenses', color=LICENSE_GOLD, fontsize=7,
                   fontweight='bold', labelpad=2)
    ax4.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor=LICENSE_GOLD, labelsize=6.5)
    ax4.set_ylim(0, max(v_lic) * 1.3)

    # ── Grid & axes ──
    ax.grid(True, which='major', axis='both', color=GRID_C, linewidth=0.5,
            alpha=0.7, zorder=0)
    ax.set_xlim(2014.3, 2024.7)
    ax.set_xticks(range(2015, 2025))
    ax.set_xlabel('')
    ax.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=9)
    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_visible(True)
        spine.set_color('#D5D5D5')
        spine.set_linewidth(0.7)
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)

    # ── Annotate 2020 pandemic acceleration ──
    i_2019, i_2020 = 4, 5  # indices for 2019, 2020
    pen_spike = v_pen[i_2020] - v_pen[i_2019]
    br_drop = v_br[i_2019] - v_br[i_2020]

    # Mark the 2019–2020 crossover band
    ax.axvspan(2019.5, 2020.5, alpha=0.06, color='#7F8C8D', zorder=0)

    # Annotate penetration spike
    ax.annotate(f'+{pen_spike:.1f} pp',
                xy=(2020, v_pen[i_2020]),
                xytext=(2019.2, v_pen[i_2020] + 9),
                fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color=color_digital,
                ha='center',
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color_digital,

                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.35', facecolor='white',

                 bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.35', facecolor='white',
                           edgecolor=color_branch, alpha=0.85))

    # ── Region title ──
    ax.set_title(region, fontsize=13.5, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_DARK,
                 pad=12)

    # ── Endpoint value labels ──
    ax.annotate(f'{v_pen[-1]:.0f}%',
                xy=(2024, v_pen[-1]), xytext=(2024.4, v_pen[-1]),
                fontsize=8, color=color_digital, fontweight='bold',
                ha='left', va='center')
    ax2.annotate(f'{v_br[-1]:.0f}K',
                 xy=(2024, v_br[-1]), xytext=(2024.4, v_br[-1]),
                 fontsize=8, color=color_branch, fontweight='bold',
                 ha='left', va='center')

# ── Shared x-axis label ──
fig.text(0.5, 0.02, 'Year', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold',
         color=TEXT_DARK, ha='center')

# ── Legend ──
legend_handles = [
    plt.Line2D([0], [0], color=DIGITAL_BLUE, linewidth=3, marker='D',
               markersize=6, markerfacecolor='white',
               markeredgecolor=DIGITAL_BLUE, markeredgewidth=2,

    plt.Line2D([0], [0], color=BRANCH_RED, linewidth=3, marker='s',

fig.text(0.5, 0.98,
         'Rising digital payment adoption and neobank growth vs. declining physical branch networks (2015–2024)',
